g.text: Observed: one launching-capture replay test, writer then independent oracle
Observed execution of one replayed test within the recording scope: a stand-in script replays a labelled synthetic
Codex exec stream through CliCapture; not a live CLI run, and not every path the code can take.
Each thread is drawn as its own block: the CliCapture$Pump thread maps the records while the main thread polls awaitEnd.
Only the listed entry methods were recorded; private methods, JSON values and the test's own code are not shown.
